label: Week of 14 September
notes: No order since 5 September — last week's plan never became a basket. The kitchen list is seeded from that receipt, so strike every perishable on it: nine days on, only the cupboard lines still hold.

Three Asian dinners, four European, which is the 50/50 rule as close as seven divides. Chinese lands at Thursday lunch rather than at dinner. No chilli anywhere, and no cream: the carbonara is egg and parmesan, the pain perdu is made on almond milk.

Eleven of the fourteen dishes have never been served — the Italian, Spanish, air-fryer and muffin-tin recipes added on 6 September had all sat unused. Nothing from last week repeats. Hob, air fryer, oven and muffin tin each get a night.
If the Drive slot slips to Tuesday, shift everything a day — but move the gyoza forward, not back: the Ginza trays are fresh and no longer keep the way the delisted frozen pack did.
The recipes add up to eleven baguettes. Order three packs of Chabrior demi-baguettes précuites instead and bake them as you go — same equivalence group, and they don't go stale by Wednesday.

The two coffees and the olive oil stay on the order by her decision (2026-09-14), which is 42 € of it. She cut the gambas night and the second bag of litter the same day: the gambas became pisto, whose parmesan is already bought for the carbonara, and the litter is one bag this week only — the standing order in preferences.json is still a pair, because that is what the receipts show.

meals.note: Nothing to cook on the day the order lands.
Fresh Ginza gyoza now the Ajinomoto frozen pack is delisted — cook it the night the order lands rather than letting it sit. Broccoli here, and again Wednesday and Friday.
Roll them Monday evening while the gyoza pan cools.
Pancetta is a guess — check the name at the Drive. Off the heat for the eggs.
Cook the whole packet of basmati — Thursday's lunch is what's left.
Wednesday's rice with an egg through it.
32 minutes but almost none of it yours. Batch the mini quiches in the oven while the air fryer runs.

Was the gambas treat night; Charlotte cut it on 2026-09-14 to bring the basket down. Keeps the Spanish night and the batch cook serves four, so there is a bowl spare.
